title: Exponent notation is not preserved, and that is fine - this fixture calibrates the oracle
rationale: Two jobs. It states honestly that JSON number TEXT is not round-tripped, and it calibrates the oracle for the whole corpus: a harness must fail exactly this and also fail vd-decimal-scale-and-precision, while passing the lossless fixtures. It also carries 1e2 beside the integer 100, pinning the 1-vs-1.0 type distinction at the JSON level.
catchesBugClass: An oracle miscalibrated in either direction, which would invalidate every other fixture verdict. Also catches an integer silently widening to a double.
cannotCatch: Says nothing about whether any VALUE is preserved - three of its four fields are the same number. It earns its place only as a paired constraint with vd-decimal-scale-and-precision.

predicted.detail: The three fractional spellings converge on one canonical form; the integer stays an integer. Nothing about the VALUE is lost.
